name: Chomper

specialAbility.name: Big Bite
specialAbility.description: Opens its huge jaws and chomps down on the enemy, stealing their health to heal itself!

lore: Chomper is basically a giant mouth on wheels! With razor-sharp teeth painted across its massive front bumper and two glowing eyes on the hood, this beast looks like it wants to eat everything in sight — because it does! Every time it bites an opponent, it actually gets stronger. Nom nom nom!
